item.title: Putin arrives in India ahead of BRICS summit
item.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi, India's capital, ahead of the BRICS summit scheduled to take place this weekend. During his visit, Putin is expected to meet with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and hold additional bilateral meetings.
BRICS comprises Russia, Brazil, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia and the United Arab Emirates. The summit will be held in New Delhi on September 12 and 13.

item.title: Trump: I have no regrets over Iran war, I'd do it again
item.description: Trump says he would make the same decision to strike Iran's nuclear sites, warning Tehran will not be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon.

item.title: Winter expected to reject surplus agreement with Hendel, but won't rule out Ben Gvir
item.description:
Yoaz Hendel, chairman of the Reservists Party, approached Ofer Winter, chairman of the Amcha Yisrael Party, with an offer to sign a surplus-vote agreement, but Winter is expected to reject it, Kan 11 News reported Thursday evening.
However, Winter has not ruled out the possibility of signing a surplus-vote agreement with Itamar Ben Gvir's Otzma Yehudit party. Likud plans to pressure Ben Gvir to sign such an agreement later on, despite its negative stance toward Winter.

item.title: Selichot at Western Wall: Over 50,000 worshippers gather ahead of Rosh Hashanah
item.description: Around 50,000 people attend late night Selichot service at the Western Wall. Rabbis and public figures pray for unity, the safety of Israel's soldiers and the recovery of the wounded.

item.title: Report: Two vessels attacked in Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said it had received a report of two vessels being attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, approximately 6.5 kilometers west of Khasab, Oman.
According to the agency, the crew of another vessel reported seeing four unidentified missiles strike the two vessels. A fire broke out on one of them, while the condition of the second vessel was unknown. UKMTO reports indicate that several vessels in the area have been affected in recent days amid ongoing military operations.
